tasks.name: Luikov coupled heat+mass transfer inverse problem
tasks.deliverable: src/data/spatial_reconstruction/luikov.py: 1D Luikov coupled heat+mass forward solver (T and moisture u as state variables) with 3 dimensionless parameters (Luikov number Lu, Kossovitch number Ko, Biot number Bi). fit_luikov_inverse: 5-param inverse fit (x_core, Lu, Ko, Bi, T_oven_eff) using Levenberg-Marquardt or Nelder-Mead; Hessian-based correlation matrix. tests/test_luikov_research.py: forward sanity vs published Luikov reference, synthetic recovery, real-CSV viability sweep, LOO subset on 3 representative fixtures. tests/_driver_luikov.py: end-to-end driver. tests/baselines/luikov_inverse_research.md: report with comparison vs M9 Stefan, M12 Zurcher, and M13 LOO baseline. NOT wired into runtime classifier.
tasks.validation_required: Forward solver passes a Luikov-equation analytical sanity (e.g. uncoupled limit reduces to heat equation; small-Lu limit recovers slow-moisture quasi-steady-state). Synthetic recovery: known (Lu, Ko, Bi, x_core) recovered within 30%. Real-CSV joint inverse converges on at least 5 of 7 fixtures. LOO subset (3 fixtures) reports held-out RMSE per held-out sensor. Existing M1-M13 tests untouched.
